The network then pools those features over each brick footprint, scores a placement at every layer, and uses a learned softmax gate to pick the landing layer. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

H1 = 48
PROJ = 16
HID = 16
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = spec.in_channels + self.Z
        self.l1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, H1, 1)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(H1, H1, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(H1, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * H1, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        eye = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        lay = eye.view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        o = obs.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, C, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([o, lay], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, C + Z, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.l1(x))
        h = F.relu(h + self.l2(h))
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            r = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1))))
            r = r.view(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
            s = r[:, :, 0]
            w = torch.softmax(r[:, :, 1], dim=1)
            res.append((w * s).sum(1))
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        hv = h.view(B, Z, H1, Y, X)
        gf = torch.cat([hv.mean((1, 3, 4)), hv.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(gf)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 3}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 3}

H = 40
PROJ = 16
HID = 16
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        Z = self.Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = spec.in_channels + 12 + 1 + Z
        self.l1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, H, 1)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(H, H, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(H, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * H, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        per = torch.stack([obs[:, 0:Z], obs[:, Z:2 * Z], obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z], obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]], dim=2)
        zero = torch.zeros_like(per[:, :1])
        below = torch.cat([zero, per[:, :-1]], dim=1)
        above = torch.cat([per[:, 1:], zero], dim=1)
        o = obs.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, C, Y, X)
        zpos = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        eye = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([o, below, per, above, zpos, eye], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, -1, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.l1(x))
        h = F.relu(h + self.l2(h))
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            r = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1))))
            r = r.view(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
            s = r[:, :, 0]
            w = torch.softmax(r[:, :, 1], dim=1)
            res.append((w * s).sum(1))
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        hv = h.view(B, Z, H, Y, X)
        gf = torch.cat([hv.mean((1, 3, 4)), hv.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(gf)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2}

T = 32
HP = 64
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = spec.in_channels
        self.t1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, T, 1)
        self.t2 = nn.Conv2d(T, T, 3, padding=1)
        self.patch = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(cin + T, HP, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.hid = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HP, HP, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HP, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * T, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        t = F.relu(self.t1(obs))
        t = F.relu(t + self.t2(t))
        f = torch.cat([obs, t], dim=1)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), pc, hd, out in zip(self.fps, self.patch, self.hid, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(f, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            h = F.relu(pc(q))
            h = F.relu(h + hd(h))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1}

W = 40
DEPTH = 4
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + 2, W, 1)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(DEPTH)])
        self.gls = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(2 * W, W) for _ in range(DEPTH)])
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(W, self.nt, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        yy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.stem(torch.cat([obs, yy, xx], dim=1)))
        for conv, gl in zip(self.convs, self.gls):
            g = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
            h = F.relu(h + conv(h) + gl(g).view(B, W, 1, 1))
        place = self.out(h).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1, "gamma": 0.99, "ent_coef": 0.003}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1}

D = 64
NH = 4
LAYERS = 2
G = 64


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(D, NH, batch_first=True)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(D, 2 * D), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(2 * D, D))

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.n1(x)
        a = self.attn(y, y, y, need_weights=False)[0]
        x = x + a
        x = x + self.ff(self.n2(x))
        return x


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        n = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.embed = nn.Linear(spec.in_channels, D)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, n, D) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block() for _ in range(LAYERS)])
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(D, self.nt, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        t = obs.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        h = self.embed(t) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)
        h = self.nf(h)
        grid = h.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        place = self.out(grid).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean(1), h.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.002, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 40
DEPTH = 4
G = 64
DONE_PRIOR = -2.0


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.np_ = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt + 2, W, 1)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(DEPTH)])
        self.gls = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(2 * W, W) for _ in range(DEPTH)])
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(W, self.nt, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.np_].reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X).to(obs.dtype)
        yy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m, yy, xx], dim=1)))
        for conv, gl in zip(self.convs, self.gls):
            g = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
            h = F.relu(h + conv(h) + gl(g).view(B, W, 1, 1))
        place = self.out(h).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        done = self.done_head(g) + DONE_PRIOR
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.02}

T = 32
HP = 64
G = 64
DONE_PRIOR = -2.0


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.np_ = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = spec.in_channels + self.nt
        self.t1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, T, 1)
        self.t2 = nn.Conv2d(T, T, 3, padding=1)
        self.patch = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(cin + T, HP, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.hid = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HP, HP, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HP, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * T, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.np_].reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X).to(obs.dtype)
        x = torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1)
        t = F.relu(self.t1(x))
        t = F.relu(t + self.t2(t))
        f = torch.cat([x, t], dim=1)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), pc, hd, out in zip(self.fps, self.patch, self.hid, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(f, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            h = F.relu(pc(q))
            h = F.relu(h + hd(h))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        done = self.done_head(g) + DONE_PRIOR
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.002, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DONE_PRIOR = -2.0


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.np_ = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.np_].reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X).to(obs.dtype)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        done = self.done_head(g) + DONE_PRIOR
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: No trials have run yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds, so for now any reliable non-zero score counts as progress. I see two likely bottlenecks. (1) Architecture: to choose a good placement, the agent has to know where a brick will land (the maximum column height under its footprint). It then has to check that every cell at that layer is missing from the build and that nothing below will be sealed. The baseline's 2D trunk mixes all layers together, which makes the conjunction "landing at layer z AND all cells missing at z" hard to learn. (2) Recipe: the default recipe gives only about 32 PPO updates, which may be too few. This round is a factorial: a layer-aware footprint head with the default recipe, the same head with a recipe that gives more updates, and the baseline network with that recipe. Together they separate the effects of architecture and recipe.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scored 0 on dev and also had 0 training success in the last 10%. That includes the baseline with a more-updates recipe and the layer-aware gated head with both recipes. With all results at 0 we have no signal yet, so the main question is what would let the agent learn to build anything exactly at all. In r1c1 every layer copy saw the same full column plus a one-hot of z. To read 'build/missing at layer z' it had to learn multiplicative interactions, and to read 'height equals z' it had to compare against a number it was never given. Both are hard for 1x1 linear layers. Fixes: slice the layer-local slab (z-1, z, z+1) explicitly and add a scalar z/Z channel that matches the height channels' scale. Separately, test more samples with fewer epochs, and a different design: a learned conv the size of each brick footprint, which reads the exact cells a brick covers, followed by an MLP.
analyses.3: All six trials score 0.000 on dev, and training success is also 0. That holds across four architecture families and recipes from 1 to 4 epochs and 131k to 426k steps, so none of them has learned anything measurable. Two candidate causes fit this. First, the designs I built in may assume the wrong world: the layer-slab heads depend on the stated channel order, and the footprint pooling depends on the stated anchor convention. Second, every network so far has been shallow and short-sighted, seeing only a few cells around each anchor and no global build status. The task notes this world may differ from its description. So this round drops hand-built structural assumptions. It uses generic, deeper networks with wider context, global broadcast and a learned 3x3 output head, plus recipes with many samples. It also tests the baseline with a recipe aimed at exact builds: higher gamma and lower entropy.
analyses.4:
After 9 trials, every run scored exactly 0: dev success and training success, on both seeds. The trials covered footprint-pooling heads, per-layer gated heads, footprint-kernel convs, generic deep convs and a transformer, with recipes from 4 epochs down to 1 epoch at about 426k steps and gamma up to 0.99. Because the generic architectures also failed, a wrong guess about channels or the anchor convention is probably not the main cause.

My leading suspicion is that the policy collapses early onto DONE. At the start most placements are wrong and earn negative reward, while DONE ends the episode at 0, so the policy may learn to stop before it ever finds exact builds. The results don't show this directly; it is a hypothesis.

For the final round I apply the same fix to three different architectures (generic residual conv, footprint-kernel conv, baseline). Each adds the legality mask as learned input channels and a constant -2 offset on the DONE logit. Each uses 1 PPO epoch for the most samples, with gamma 0.99 and lambda 0.95. If all three still score 0, collapse onto DONE was not the bottleneck.
